# tenarium_tenant (Resource)

A tenant (customer, organization or workspace). Tenants can be nested with `parent_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tenarium_tenant" "acme" {
  slug   = "acme"
  name   = "Acme Inc."
  plan   = tenarium_plan.pro.id
  region = "eu" # changing it later moves the tenant

  # Add-on plans stacked on the plan.
  add_ons = [tenarium_plan.extra_seats.id]

  labels = {
    tier = "gold"
  }

  # Any JSON object; formatting and key order do not cause diffs.
  settings = jsonencode({
    theme  = { color = "#0050ff" }
    locale = "en"
  })

  # Overrides on top of the plan.
  features = { beta = true }
  limits   = { members = 100 }

  # Monthly billing cycles start on the 15th.
  billing_anchor = "2026-01-15T00:00:00Z"

  branding = {
    display_name  = "Acme"
    logo_url      = "https://acme.example/logo.svg"
    primary_color = "#0050ff"
    support_email = "support@acme.example"
  }

  deletion_protection = true
}

# A workspace nested under the organization.
resource "tenarium_tenant" "acme_dev" {
  slug      = "acme-dev"
  name      = "Acme (dev)"
  parent_id = tenarium_tenant.acme.id

  # Skip the server's deletion grace period on destroy.
  force_delete = true
}

# A tenant preset by a template: plan, region, labels, branding and custom
# roles come from the template unless configured here.
resource "tenarium_tenant" "globex" {
  slug     = "globex"
  name     = "Globex"
  template = tenarium_tenant_template.startup.id

  # Stay on revision 3 of the plan instead of following its changes.
  plan_revision = 3
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe unique identifier. Changing it replaces the tenant.

### Optional

- `add_ons` (Set of String) IDs of add-on plans stacked on the plan (at most 20; requires `plans:write`). When unset at creation with a `template`, the tenant gets and keeps the template's value (Terraform leaves it alone until you configure it). Otherwise an unset value is empty, and removing the attribute from the configuration clears it.
- `billing_anchor` (String) Start of the tenant's monthly billing cycles for `cycle` usage periods, as an RFC 3339 timestamp (requires `plans:write`). Spellings of the same instant are equal. Set it to `""` to remove the anchor (cycles then start at the creation time); when omitted, Terraform keeps whatever anchor the tenant has, e.g. one set by a billing plugin.
- `branding` (Attributes) Look of the tenant's sign-in pages and emails. Every change replaces the whole branding. When unset at creation with a `template`, the tenant gets and keeps the template's value (Terraform leaves it alone until you configure it). Otherwise an unset value is empty, and removing the attribute from the configuration clears it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--branding))
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) When true, `terraform destroy` (or a replacement) fails instead of deleting the tenant. Defaults to `false`.
- `features` (Map of Boolean) Feature overrides on top of the plan. When unset at creation with a `template`, the tenant gets and keeps the template's value (Terraform leaves it alone until you configure it). Otherwise an unset value is empty, and removing the attribute from the configuration clears it.
- `force_delete` (Boolean) When true, deletion skips the server's deletion grace period (`?force=true`, requires the `tenants:purge` permission). Defaults to `false`.
- `labels` (Map of String) Key/value labels used for filtering. When unset at creation with a `template`, the tenant gets and keeps the template's value (Terraform leaves it alone until you configure it). Otherwise an unset value is empty, and removing the attribute from the configuration clears it.
- `limits` (Map of Number) Limit overrides on top of the plan. When unset at creation with a `template`, the tenant gets and keeps the template's value (Terraform leaves it alone until you configure it). Otherwise an unset value is empty, and removing the attribute from the configuration clears it.
- `move_reprovision` (Boolean) When true, a change of `region` re-runs the provisioners in the new region inside a maintenance window (the tenant is `provisioning` until they succeed). Needs provisioner plugins on the server. Defaults to `false`.
- `parent_id` (String) ID of the parent tenant, for hierarchies such as organization and workspace. Changing it replaces the tenant.
- `plan` (String) ID of the plan the tenant subscribes to. When omitted, the server decides (child tenants inherit their parent's plan, a `template` may set one) and Terraform keeps whatever plan the tenant has; set it to `""` to clear it.
- `plan_revision` (Number) Revision of the plan the tenant is pinned to (see the `tenarium_plan_revisions` data source); `0` follows the current plan. When omitted, Terraform leaves the pin alone, for example one set by updating a plan with `grandfather_on_update`, and only reports it. Changing `plan` resets the pin on the server. Requires `plans:write`.
- `region` (String) Region the tenant is placed in (data residency). When omitted at creation, the parent's region, the template's region or the server's default region applies, and Terraform keeps whatever region the tenant has. Changing it moves the tenant (`POST /v1/tenants/{id}/move`, requires `tenants:move`) instead of replacing it. A region cannot be removed.
- `settings` (String) Tenant settings as a JSON object string, typically built with `jsonencode()`. Formatting and key order differences are ignored. When unset at creation with a `template`, the tenant gets and keeps the template's value (Terraform leaves it alone until you configure it). Otherwise an unset value is empty, and removing the attribute from the configuration clears it.
- `template` (String) ID of a tenant template (`tenarium_tenant_template`) that presets the tenant at creation: plan, add-ons, region, labels, settings, features, limits, branding and custom roles. Attributes set in the configuration win: for those, the tenant ends up exactly as configured (template map entries and settings keys not in the configuration are removed). Only used when the tenant is created; changing or removing it later has no effect and does not replace the tenant. Empty after an import.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Tenant ID (UUID).
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status: `provisioning`, `active`, `suspended`, `failed`, `deleting` or `deleted`.
- `version` (Number) Version of the tenant, incremented on every write. Updates send it as `If-Match`, so changes made outside Terraform since the last refresh fail instead of being overwritten.

<a id="nestedatt--branding"></a>
### Nested Schema for `branding`

Optional:

- `accent_color` (String) Accent color as `#rrggbb`.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown instead of the tenant name.
- `icon_url` (String) HTTPS URL of the icon (favicon).
- `logo_url` (String) HTTPS URL of the logo.
- `primary_color` (String) Primary color as `#rrggbb`.
- `support_email` (String) Support email address.
- `support_url` (String) HTTPS URL of the support site.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By ID or by slug.
terraform import tenarium_tenant.acme 0190f3a2-7c55-7d1e-9b8a-3f2a1c4d5e6f
terraform import tenarium_tenant.acme acme
```
